summary: This research study compares a new drug called NNC0487-0111 against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine, in people who have heart failure and obesity. Heart failure is a condition where the heart cannot pump blood as well as it should. The study is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and aims to enroll 5610 participants. Participants will receive either the study drug or a placebo by injection once a week.
